question: Which breeze will carry your heart to adventure?
intro_environment: A sweeping vista of the Whispering Winds, a vast expanse of rolling dunes, wind-sculpted cliffs, and a distant horizon where the sky meets the earth in swirling ribbons of airy light.
intro_camera: Wide landscape camera, slightly low angle to capture the sweeping horizon and the subtle movement of the wind.
intro_couple_action: A small, nimble couple walks along a narrow ridge, trailing a softly glowing lantern, listening to the wind's whispers as they explore the world.

choices.title: Mist Veil Lagoon
choices.description: A serene lagoon shrouded in morning mist, with lily pads and a solitary stone bridge.
choices.composition: Central composition with a diagonal path leading into depth.
choices.camera: Low angle, slightly zoomed to emphasize water reflection.
choices.dominant_palette: Cool blues and soft greens with silver mist.
choices.couple_action: The couple gently floats a paper boat across the water.

choices.title: Starlit Grove
choices.description: A luminous forest where bioluminescent fungi glow along ancient trunks.
choices.composition: Vertical composition with towering trees framing the couple.
choices.camera: Medium shot, slightly elevated to capture canopy.
choices.dominant_palette: Deep purples, emerald greens, and phosphorescent teal.
choices.couple_action: The couple climbs a tree to observe glowing spores.

choices.title: Nimbus Overlook
choices.description: A lofty treehouse perched on a colossal floating cloud, connected by rope bridges.
choices.composition: Dynamic composition with overlapping layers of clouds and branches.
choices.camera: High angle, slightly wide to show the treehouse and surrounding sky.
choices.dominant_palette: Soft pastels: blush pink, lavender, and sky blue.
choices.couple_action: The couple swings on a rope bridge, laughing.

choices.title: Echoing Caves
choices.description: A vast cavern with crystal formations that echo when wind passes.
choices.composition: Symmetrical composition with a central stalactite.
choices.camera: Wide shot, slightly tilted to capture cavern depth.
choices.dominant_palette: Muted grays, icy blues, and glinting silver.
choices.couple_action: The couple explores a crystal tunnel, holding lanterns.
